insight.mets_rationalization: This initiative directly supports the development of advanced digital sensing and secure communication infrastructure, aligning with long-term regulatory anchors for national security, critical infrastructure protection, and the adoption of cutting-edge digital technologies for environmental monitoring and industrial precision.
